description: Create a tasting note on a CarlNotes topic or team page, or change one you may edit. With no note_id, it creates a note from a name and a visibility the page allows. With a note_id, it saves a new name, a new visibility, which only the note's author changes, or a new html body, which needs the version read_notes returned. A body save replaces the whole note and keeps no history, and a stale version saves nothing. Use it when the user asks Carl or CarlNotes to write a note, add a tasting note, or edit my note.

html.description: The note's whole new body as html.

note_id.description: The note to change. Leave it out to create a note.

team_id.description: A team whose page holds the notes, in place of topic_id.

topic_id.description: The topic's id. Optional on a topic-bound server, which already knows its topic.

version.description: The version read_notes returned, which a body save needs.

name: save_note
title: Save a tasting note
